text:
marta: FYI I opened a small PR to refresh the Quickstart "hello" app and onboarding steps. Main changes: switch to SDK8 async examples, simplify env var guidance, and a tiny Dockerfile clarification. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/712
owen: Sweet. Can you list the breaking snippet diffs so reviewers know what to look for?
marta: Sure: 1) python sync -> async, 2) remove legacy token file pattern, 3) replace inline sed with a Python one-liner for cross-platform safety, 4) add note about short-lived keys and rotation.
docs-bot: snippet-tests triggered for PR #712 (build 3612).
sam: Quick nit: the example Dockerfile exposes port 5000 but the sample app listens on 8080. Either change EXPOSE or the app port. Caught this locally.
marta: Good catch, changing Dockerfile to 8080 and adding quick dev vs prod comment. Pushing fix.
owen: Also the curl example used a lowercased "authorization" header; canonicalize to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` in all snippets.
toni: For the token rotation blurb, can we add a one-line link to the KMS integration guide and mention that customers can swap keys without app downtime if they use env var reload?
marta: Yep adding a link + a one-sentence tip about env reloaders (like supervisord/systemd).
docs-bot: snippet-tests failed on macos due to sed usage in setup snippet. Log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/712/snippet-log.
sam: My recommendation: replace sed line with `python -c "import sys,io; s=sys.stdin.read().replace('PLACEHOLDER', sys.argv[1]); print(s)" "VALUE"` — works on mac/win/linux with python available.
owen: That works. Also add a comment noting Python requirement for that step.
marta: Replaced sed with the Python one-liner and added a short comment. Updated PR.
docs-bot: All checks passed for PR #712  build 3612.
marta: Merging once the site build finishes. Thanks for the quick reviews!
sam: Approved. Small follow-up: can we add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ entry about common auth errors (invalid token vs missing header)? I've got a few support tickets that could be prevented.
owen: Agree, a short two-bullet FAQ would help.
marta: Added a brief FAQ section to the onboarding page and linked it from the quickstart. Pushed.
docs-bot: Site deploy succeeded to staging.
marta: Verified staging, everything looks good. Closing thread 389
